labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Import: what to change for bulk changes
labels.value: To let someone who is not a BarnCRM Admin bulk update, or anyone bulk delete, assign BarnCRM Bulk Update or BarnCRM Bulk Delete, with BarnCRM Find and Export.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Import: Setup path for bulk permissions
labels.value: Setup, Users, the person, Permission Set Assignments

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Import: why bulk permissions need Setup
labels.value: These permission sets are in no role on purpose (bulk delete not even in BarnCRM Admin), so nobody has them until you decide.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: the prerequisite is already done
labels.value: Done

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Households: what to change for duplicates
labels.value: To review duplicates, assign BarnCRM Duplicate Review to the people who will do it, and keep the standard duplicate rules active.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Households: Setup path for duplicates
labels.value: Setup, Users, Permission Set Assignments; Setup, Duplicate Rules

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Households: why duplicates need Setup
labels.value: Salesforce shows possible duplicates only to users with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license, and a scan applies only active duplicate rules.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: what to change for email
labels.value: Let this org send email, so the error digest can be delivered.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: Setup path for email
labels.value: Setup, Deliverability, Access level: All email

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: why email needs Setup
labels.value: When Deliverability is set to system email only or no access, Salesforce sends no digest, and only Setup can change it.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: what to change for the fiscal year
labels.value: Start the fiscal year in Setup in the same month as Fiscal year start month in this section.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: Setup path for the fiscal year
labels.value: Setup, Company Settings, Fiscal Year

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: why the fiscal years must match
labels.value: Salesforce reports, including the retention reports, read the fiscal year in Setup, and BarnCRM totals read the one here. If the months differ, they disagree about what counts as this year.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: heading above what to change in Setup
labels.value: Needs a change in Setup

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: what to change for Custom Metadata
labels.value: To save Custom Metadata entries here, assign BarnCRM Metadata Admin to yourself and turn on Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: Setup path for Custom Metadata
labels.value: Setup, Users, your name, Permission Set Assignments; then Setup, Apex Settings

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: why Custom Metadata needs Setup
labels.value: Saving an entry changes the org's metadata. Salesforce lets an installed package do that only with this switch on, and only Setup can turn it on.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: the prerequisite is not done yet
labels.value: Not done yet

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: what to change for a new rollup
labels.value: Create the field a new rollup writes its total to before you build the rollup.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: Setup path for a new field
labels.value: Setup, Object Manager, the object, Fields & Relationships, New

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: why rollup fields need Setup
labels.value: The Rollup Builder picks a field that already exists. Creating a field changes the org's data model, which only Setup does.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: what to change for module access
labels.value: Assign a module's own permission set (Giving Staff, for example) to people who need that module, alongside their role here.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: Setup path for module permission sets
labels.value: Setup, Users, the person, Permission Set Assignments

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: why module permission sets need Setup
labels.value: A role here carries what Core provides, not what a module adds, and a module's permission set can be assigned only in Setup for now.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: prefix before the Setup path
labels.value: Where in Setup:
